name: NASA GIBS layer catalog
description: Retrieval nodes for the NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) layer catalog: the WMTS 1.0.0 Capabilities documents for EPSG:3857, EPSG:3413 and EPSG:3031, the GIBS layer metadata (measurement, platform and instrument, period, ongoing, day/night, CMR collections) and DescribeDomains for each layer whose time list stops at the 100 values a Capabilities document carries. plan_capabilities asks for the three documents; plan_details parses them in WASM and queues the per-layer requests in 30 batches; advance absorbs a batch and asks for the next; build_catalog writes one merged WMTS 1.0.0 Capabilities document (every layer, polar-only layers with their own renamed TileMatrixSets, licence, attribution and the WMS endpoint for vector layers as ows:Metadata); announce_catalog turns the IPFS add result into one $PNM. Fetching, IPFS and storage belong to the host; the node's auto-publisher announces the PNM.fbs lane provider nasa-gibs, source layer-catalog.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic XML and JSON parsing and one document write per cycle. No host calls, threads or network access.
